features.title: Purchased packs stay current
features.description: Already-activated packs check for updates at startup. Changed files download while verified unchanged files are reused; interrupted updates preserve the installed pack.

features.title: Browse and build more comfortably
features.description: Terrain previews load progressively. A Content library brings terrain, characters, personal scenery and campaign sounds together, with artwork cards and compact campaign tools.

features.title: Better planning and bounded history
features.description: Structured roads, rivers, landings and access areas can be checked during placement. Campaign history has storage limits that preserve current work and active undo snapshots.

features.title: Understand and control online AI
features.description: Review key encryption, data sharing and provider charges before enabling AI. Test OpenAI, Claude and Meshy separately, see account errors clearly, and reset session usage while retaining lifetime totals.
